Based on a precise comparison of the two screenshots:

(1) **Yes**, the flower icon is a different size. In the first screenshot, the icon appears slightly larger and more "open" (expanded), while in the second screenshot, it has contracted to a smaller size, indicating a pulsing or breathing animation.

(2) **Yes**, the soft orange glow behind the flower is of a different intensity. The glow in the first image is noticeably brighter and more diffused (larger radius), whereas in the second image, the glow is dimmer and tighter around the icon, consistent with the pulsing effect.

(3) **No**, the status text ("Reading your homepage...") does not appear to have a gradient highlight at a different position; it remains static solid text in both frames. However, if you are referring to the **"Analyzing..." button**, then **yes**, the subtle internal shading or highlight on that button appears to have shifted slightly between the two frames.
